changes.derivedValue: That year Huang campaigned against Gaogouli; King Gao Zhen begged alliance and returned.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhen sued for peace and he withdrew.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: The next year, Zhen sent his heir apparent to court at Huang.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: The next year Gao Zhen sent his heir to pay homage to Huang.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Goguryeo King Zhen thought Huang’s army came by the northern route; thereupon sent his younger brother Wu leading picked fifty thousand to block Beizhi; personally led weak soldiers to guard the southern defile.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: King Gao Zhen assumed the main thrust would come from the north, sent fifty thousand under his brother Wu to Beizhi, and held the southern defile with weaker troops.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Han fought Zhen at Mudi, greatly defeated them, rode victory then entered Wandu; Zhen single horse fled.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Murong Han routed him at Mudi, pressed into Wandu, and Zhen fled alone on horseback.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Huang dug Zhen’s father Li’s tomb, loaded his corpse together with his mother, wife, and treasures, plundered over fifty thousand male and female, burned his palace chambers, destroyed Wandu and returned.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Huang opened Gao Zhen’s father Li’s tomb, carried off the corpse together with Zhen’s mother, wife, and treasures, plundered more than fifty thousand men and women, fired the palaces, and razed Wandu.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: The next year, Zhen sent envoys declaring subject to Huang, offered their local products, then returned his father’s corpse.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: The next year Gao Zhen sent envoys declaring himself a subject of Huang, offered local products, and Huang then returned his father’s corpse.
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Le said: “If like your words, why did the prince duke not employ them?”
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Shi Le asked, "If what you say is so, why did Prince Wang not employ him?"
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision

changes.derivedValue: Song answered, “Because he could not use them, you captured him.”
changes.source: Exact other English field in the same sealed transport unit; host-derived context, not a new model decision
